findings: Normative contract and OpenSpec NR-01–06 alignment: candidate/docs/CORE-EXECUTION-REPORTS.md and the child additions in candidate/openspec/changes/consolidated-language-kernel/specs/consolidated-language-kernel/spec.md (matching normative/OPENSPEC.patch verbatim under UNI-018, UNI-020, UNI-021, and UNI-024) accurately specify the adopted design (DESIGN-ADOPTION.json) for normal accepted moriarty/1 (moriarty-core/1) actions over Let, Requires, Next, Ensures, and Emit plus the N=0 empty-action boundary, while preserving all parent exits and requirement denominators.

Provenance and byte-identical freeze custody: All 20 payload files plus FREEZE.sha256 in candidate/crates/fixtures/core-report-contract/ are byte-for-byte identical to independent-oracles/. The freeze is properly disclosed as a post-adoption custodian derivation from the adopted contract and literal arithmetic (not blind or preimplementation, and without invoking any Moriarty parser/evaluator/exporter or actual output), while preserving prior freezes 80ddf5ab686198f176b60f5641b2d7f652bd33e8324db52d9abff2ff6590c1d5 and 481f6d56f12e87730ae7b05324a7563ef1ea311800e9177f88f1f1b1ca81e29a.

Counter specimen (run, amount=UInt 7) verification: Starting from empty supplied state (selecting declared count=UInt 0), statement indexes 0..4 carry exact statement expression roots 2, 5, 6, 9, 10 (from the 11-node arena 0..10 where StateDecl initializers are direct literals outside Program.expressions). Step0 Let total reports statement.value ExprId 2 and present outer Step.value UInt 7 with snapshot S0 (count=0) and effects []; Step1 Requires reports Bool true with S0 and effects []; Step2 Next reports outer UInt 7, updates snapshot to S7 (count=7), and emits local delta [State(count: 0->7)]; Step3 Ensures reads updated count=7 and retained capture total=7, reporting Bool true with S7 and local delta []; Step4 Emit reports UInt 7 with S7 and local delta [Emit(count, UInt 7)]. Execution.effects is the ordered concatenation [State, Emit], and neither amount nor total leaks into Snapshot.state. Under moriarty-reference-logical-cost/1 (1 per statement dispatch + 1 per uncached expression node with per-statement cache reset), statement work increments are 4, 4, 2, 4, 2 totaling 16, matching cap16 (cap='16', used='16') and capmax (cap='340282366920938463463374607431768211455', used='16').

Empty-action specimen (idle, N=0) and financial frame verification: empty-frame.mori and empty-frame.scenario.json preserve declared initial states (count=UInt 5, ready=Bool true), all three canonical (asset, account) CASH (local, normal-report-empty-oracle, CASH, scale 2) balances (beneficiary=11, observer=23, treasury=97; opening/closing sum=131; zero gross debit/fee/net change/mint/burn/refund/rounding dust), and the positive residual liability reserve=17 (treasury->beneficiary). The uninvoked declare() action supplies source-wide liability identity registration without executing or contributing steps/work. At N=0, steps=[], post=pre, effects=[], with no synthetic Step or Step.value, and 0 primitive logical work used at cap='0'.

Production consumer and serialization path inspection: Inspecting candidate/crates/mori/src/commands/simulate.rs, core_io.rs, test.rs, and candidate/crates/mori-core/src/{ir.rs,runtime.rs,logical_cost.rs,parser.rs,json.rs} confirms no production or dependency changes in the candidate. In simulate.rs (lines 119-123 and 138-140), ordinary and metered accepted envelopes are constructed via serde_json::json!({...}) (which converts Execution into BTreeMap-backed serde_json::Value objects with lexicographically ordered keys at every nesting level) and printed via core_io::print -> mori_core::json::export (2-space pretty ASCII-safe JSON) followed by println! (single trailing LF) and ExitCode::SUCCESS with no status text on stderr. Consumer separation is preserved: the 28,093-byte (b57043f1...) normal Transfer pin in core_test_report.rs belongs to the mori test aggregate consumer (cases[].actual.Ok), not the 3-field mori simulate envelope.

Integration test implementation (candidate/crates/mori/tests/core_report_contract.rs): Defines two test functions covering all five positive cases (counter-unmetered, counter-cap16, counter-capmax, empty-unmetered, empty-cap0). Fixtures are embedded via relative CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR include_bytes! with no hardcoded absolute paths. Project owns a unique per-process/atomic-counter temporary directory under std::env::temp_dir() (routed to <owned>/tmp under PROPOSAL.json) and removes it in Drop; all struct fields (root, source, scenario) are actively used. Each case asserts exit code 0, empty stderr, full serde_json::Value equality, and exact stdout byte equality. Direct unwrap()/assert_eq! usage in this integration test binary check is a valid test-code exception.

Proposed one-attempt ordinary command eligibility (PROPOSAL.json and TOOL-METADATA.json): The single 90s+5s timeout invocation runs cargo test --manifest-path ... --frozen -j1 -p mori --no-default-features --test core_report_contract -- --test-threads=1. Because mori's native feature is gated behind default = ['native'] in crates/mori/Cargo.toml and mori-core's midnight-compat-tests is non-default, --no-default-features --test core_report_contract excludes mori-backend, mori-ledger, all Midnight SDK/ledger/proof/crypto crates, all 11 required-features=['native'] integration tests, and the native-gated PR191 unit tests in core_io.rs. The execution uses an owned cold target and CARGO_HOME (symlinking only public registry/git), owned empty cwd and TMPDIR, a strict 13-variable environment whitelist with no HOME or credentials, 4 SHA-256 tool pins, and a metadata-only absence recheck of all 14 ancestor Cargo config paths.
limitations: All five CLI test cases in core_report_contract and all PR191 native unit tests remain completely UNRUN; no runtime pass, compiler admission, or byte conformance is inferred from static source inspection or prior Core tests.

Full 11-node Program.expressions parser correspondence (ExprIds 0..10 for Counter and global ExprId 0 for PreservedIdleFrame) is not directly observed by mori simulate stdout alone, which serializes only the statement root ExprIds (2, 5, 6, 9, 10) inside steps[i].statement.
Source-author implementation inspection and post-adoption custodian derivation are disclosed; the freeze is not blind or preimplementation.

This review approves only the exact candidate source and the eligibility of the proposed single ordinary command attempt (nativeAuthority: 0); actual command execution results require a separate post-run result review.

All prior failures, caps, counters, and allocations are preserved without reset or reuse, and all parent roadmap/OpenSpec exits (UNI-018/020/021/024, U0–U7, M1–M17, MC, SP, G) and requirement denominators remain open.
